facts.conclusion: Actual prepare is accepted once in spawn_blocking and awaited without a cancellation select.
Both fixed local observations complete in one owned private runtime; explicit Native reap API, then ordinary runtime destruction before return.
Actual-reap mode waits the original Child; errors remain failures. Runtime destruction is not its child-wait proof.
Bounded32 page loop is entirely inside one retained synchronous worker; no business lock or USB owner is held.
Agent observer runs in its own retained blocking task/private runtime; runtime Drop joins accepted manifest filesystem work.
Every returned Begin token reaches an End attempt after page/error/cancel result; that End await is not dropped by a stop select.

Stop/budget may end ordinary read-only network awaits. Any accepted Manifest filesystem task belongs to the private runtime that is subsequently dropped/joined. Lost Begin reply can leave only bounded expiring metadata, not USB ownership.
Encoding failure discards projected payload in favor of a finite closed incomplete summary, rather than writing truncated JSON.
Both remaining encoding-error branches consume and join the original prepared owner to retain its real generated partial name/empty accepted-byte digest.
Fresh stop observation after initial encode re-encodes Cancelled and chooses partial instead of final publication before accepting finish.
Success and error use one retained blocking finish; a later signal cannot undo completed rename or turn Published into a false absent result.
Never replacing rename/unlink. Actual write-prefix counters/hash are independent of sync and cleanup; post-rename error reports Unconfirmed.
CLI installs signals before accepted work and retains/polls the same capture through repeated signals or signal-source error.
Only bounded receipt goes to EventOutput after real file work joins. Existing five-second stdout thread behavior is not represented as joining a blocked OS stdout writer.

Artifact is closed enums/numbers/booleans/aliases, not original doctor/config/log DTO serialization; local helper count remains a separate local prerequisite observation, not a per-profile resource count.
Finite8192 alias map; original mapping is never Serialize. Failure becomes explicit incomplete capture.
4MiB capped Write includes final newline and rejects extension before exceed; limits are encoded, not an after-allocation length-only check.
Agent projection verifies selected profile and original identities/commit page envelope before aliasing. State/evidence/operation/cleanup/link-end categories are retained separately.
At most32 log pages/512 source records. Original target/messages/pins/paths/serial/payload absent; closed numeric diagnostic fields only. Agent projection filters other-profile records again.
Both Read and Audit precede registry/token/expiry lookup. Four actual Arc-held snapshot permits and one-per-UID owner index are metadata only.
Authorized agent log requests use existing finite real log-reader admission, not a new unbounded exporter pool.

remaining_nonblocking_notes.scope: No setuid installation or split-UID acceptance is claimed.

remaining_nonblocking_notes.observation: Hard-blocked filesystem/kernel child wait can delay shutdown; no timeout/future drop revokes actual work.
EventOutput retains the established bounded deadline/detached stdout-only writer contract; this is not a claim that all OS threads join.
Committed history is coherent to its token/sequence; health/logs/local prerequisites are independently sampled and not one atomic device/recovery proof.
Public export documents that its future must be retained/polled after stop. This review does not claim safety when an external embedding simply drops its last future owner.

validation_boundary.method: Read actual source and relevant call chain; no producer/verifier import or application execution.
